headline: Anthropic priced its share sale at $83, above its range, ahead of its Nasdaq debut today, while bitcoin slipped to about $63,100 with fear at extreme lows after Fed minutes pointed to a December rate rise.

market.asOf: Read at about 23:54-00:00 UTC Wed 18 Nov (about 07:00 Thursday Bangkok) on CoinMarketCap, whose pages showed no exact time. CoinGecko showed similar prices (BTC about $63,157-63,181, ETH about $1,780, SOL about $73.80) but a different size of 24-hour move. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index 11 (12 yesterday, 29 a week ago, 59 a month ago); CoinMarketCap's own Fear & Greed Index also 11. Both read at about 23:55 UTC Wed 18 Nov.

stories.title: Anthropic prices its share sale at $83, above the range, before Nasdaq trading starts today
stories.summary: AI company Anthropic set its share price at $83, above the $70-78 range it had marketed, and is due to start trading on Nasdaq as ANT on Thursday. Its first day is a big test of how much appetite investors have for risk, which also matters for crypto.
points: Anthropic priced at $83 a share, above its $70-78 range, per TechCrunch; CoinDesk's live blog also reported the price, citing Bloomberg.
The deal is 980 million shares raising about $81 billion before costs, with closing expected 20 November, per investingLive's report of the company's announcement.
At $83 Anthropic is valued at about $1.5 trillion fully diluted, alongside a $26 billion private placement, per TechCrunch.
Orders were nearly 7 times the shares offered, and up to 20% of shares were set aside for individual investors through brokers, per Yahoo Finance.
Ondo is launching a token tracking ANT shares for eligible non-US investors only, per The Block.

stories.title: Fed minutes and Fed speakers point to a December rate rise
stories.summary: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting show almost all officials expect to raise interest rates again, and Fed speakers on Wednesday sounded tough on inflation. Higher rates tend to pull money away from riskier assets like crypto.
points: 'Almost all participants' judged further rate rises likely appropriate, and 'a couple' said a rise of more than a quarter point could be considered in December, per Investing.com.
The Fed held its range at 3.75-4.00% in October, per Investing.com.
Kashkari said markets believe the Fed will need to raise rates more than officials currently expect, per Newsquawk; investingLive said Barr and Daly also sounded hawkish.
Bitcoin fell about 0.6% and ether about 0.7% on Coinbase within 10 minutes of the minutes, per Phemex.
Odds of a December rise: about 96% on CME FedWatch on 18 Nov per 24/7 Wall St; 100% per a Daily Economics summary of FedWatch.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips toward $62,000 as fear stays extreme and fund outflows continue
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell again on Wednesday and is trading in the low $60,000s, near four-month lows. Money keeps leaving US bitcoin funds. Some analysts link the weakness to the AI stock sell-off and the Anthropic share sale, others disagree.
points: CryptoQuant says bitcoin hit a four-month low of $61,000 on 15 November and calls the market a bearish phase but a 'value zone', per The Block.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $239.94 million on Tuesday 17 Nov and $2.58 billion so far in November, per Bitcoin.com. Wednesday's figures were not out at the time of writing.
Bitcoin fell 23% in the 50 days before the Anthropic share sale, and its 30-day correlation with Nvidia rose from 0.20 to 0.56, per Decrypt.
Nvidia's revenue rose 103% to $115.8 billion, but its shares fell about 2.9% on Wednesday afternoon, per Motley Fool.

briefs.title: Kraken's parent agrees to buy Tribe Capital
briefs.summary: Payward agreed to buy Tribe Capital, which manages $2.7B; closing is expected in early 2027 and the price was not disclosed, per The Defiant.

briefs.title: Six senators press Treasury on stablecoin rules
briefs.summary: Senators including Lummis, Gillibrand and Warner asked Treasury Secretary Bessent to ensure equal footing for state-regulated stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance wins $6.5B freezing order over October hack
briefs.summary: Abu Dhabi courts granted a worldwide freezing order; about $2.85B of roughly $6.34B affected has been frozen or intercepted, and 26,000 wallets were identified as holding stolen assets, per The Block.

briefs.title: German judge offers deal in Movie2k bitcoin case
briefs.summary: A judge proposed dropping the case if the alleged operator hands over 40,000 BTC plus €38M; the trial resumes 3 December, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Strategy stock and its preferred shares fall
briefs.summary: MSTR fell 4% and its STRC preferred hit its lowest since August at $95.75, per CoinDesk's live blog.

briefs.title: Bullish profit rises
briefs.summary: Bullish's Q3 adjusted profit rose 35% while digital-asset sales fell 23%, per The Block.

briefs.title: Variational raises $110M
briefs.summary: The on-chain derivatives platform raised $110M at a $1.5B valuation, per The Block.
